description:
Join Leidos and help shape the future of geospatial intelligence! We are seeking talented Software Engineers at multiple experience levels to support the Maru Program and our Intelligence Community customer. Whether your expertise is in back-end development, full-stack applications, data engineering, or cloud-native technologies, you'll have the opportunity to develop mission-critical capabilities that directly support national security.

 On the Maru Program, you'll collaborate with software engineers, architects, DevSecOps engineers, and mission stakeholders to design, develop, and deliver secure, scalable applications and data platforms in a fast-paced Agile environment.

 This role is open to candidates across a range of experience levels. The scope of the position and corresponding compensation will be aligned with the selected candidate’s background and expertise. 

 Clearance Level Required 
 Active Top Secret/SCI clearance with the ability to successfully pass a Polygraph examination.


 Primary Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable software applications, services, and data platforms supporting mission-critical workflows.
 Develop back-end services and RESTful APIs using Python, Java, or similar programming languages.
 Build modern web applications and interactive dashboards using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and contemporary front-end technologies.
 Develop and optimize relational database solutions using PostgreSQL/Aurora, SQL, and modern data modeling practices.
 Design and maintain data ingestion, transformation, and analytical processing pipelines.
 Integrate applications and data services with AWS cloud infrastructure, object storage, and enterprise platforms.
 Develop, containerize, and deploy applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD practices.
 Troubleshoot complex application, database, integration, and infrastructure issues.
 Implement automated testing, secure coding practices, and performance improvements.
 Collaborate with architects, Product Owners, and engineering teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
 Participate in Agile development activities, technical design discussions, and peer code reviews.
 For senior-level candidates, provide technical leadership, architectural guidance, mentoring, and oversight of complex engineering initiatives.
 
 Required Qualifications 
 U.S. citizenship is required per contract.
 Active TS/SCI clearance with the ability to successfully pass a Polygraph examination.
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, with relevant professional experience appropriate to the position level.
 Professional experience developing, integrating, or maintaining enterprise software applications or data platforms.
 Strong programming experience in one or more languages, including Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
 Experience developing RESTful APIs, back-end services, or modern web applications.
 Experience with relational databases, SQL, and database development.
 Familiarity with Linux-based development or production environments.
 Experience with Git-based version control and collaborative software development.
 Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented programming, testing, debugging, and design principles.
 Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, containerized applications, or CI/CD practices.
 Experience working within Agile Scrum or similar iterative development environments.
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas are encouraged to apply.
 Full-Stack / Front-End Engineering 
 React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
 Python frameworks such as FastAPI or Django.
 Interactive dashboards and visualization with Grafana
 Geospatial application frameworks such as MapLibre, Mapbox, OpenLayers, or Cesium.
 Back-End / Data Engineering 
 PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL.
 Advanced SQL, data modeling, indexing, partitioning, and query optimization.
 Data pipelines, ETL, and distributed data processing.
 Amazon S3, Redshift, Apache Iceberg, Trino/Presto, or Spark.
 Kafka, Airflow, Dagster, dbt, or similar data processing technologies.
 Lakehouse architectures, metadata management, and analytical data platforms.
 Cloud / DevSecOps 
 AWS services, including EC2, S3, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, and RDS/Aurora.
 Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
 GitLab CI, Jenkins, or other CI/CD technologies.
 Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or similar tools.
 Secure software development and automated security integration.
 Additional Preferred Experience 
 Experience developing software for DoD or Intelligence Community customers.
 Experience with geospatial intelligence, telemetry, or large-scale operational datasets.
 Experience developing and supporting production systems in classified environments.
 Security+ or other DoD 8570/8140 compliant certifications.
 Experience providing technical mentorship, architectural guidance, or engineering leadership.
 
 #NSBA
 #Maru
  
 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
